title: Jazzy Glassy-Jelly Moroccan Lamb Msemen
description:
Earthy, glassy-jelly Moroccan dish featuring extra virgin olive oil, namul-blanch-season, macrobiotic-friendly.
This msemen is perfect for meal prep with its versatility and nutritional balance.
instructions: Combine lamb, Namul-Blanch-Season, Salt, and Black Pepper in a bowl and mix well.
Heat 60ml of Extra Virgin Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add chopped Garlic and Ginger to the pan and saut9 for 2 minutes.
Mix in glassy-jelly and cook for 3 minutes, until heated through.
Combine Wheat Flour and Water in a separate bowl to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 6 equal portions and shape into msemen.
Heat 60ml of Extra Virgin Olive Oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Cook msemen for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Repeat the cooking process for the remaining dough portions.
Cut the cooked msemen into wedges and garnish with Chopped Fresh Mint and Chopped Fresh Cilantro.
Serve hot with your favorite accompaniments.
Transfer the cooked msemen to a lazy-susan-spinner for easy serving and meal prep.
Refrigerate or freeze the msemen for up to 3 days or 2 months respectively.
Reheat the msemen in the microwave or a non-stick pan before serving.
Assemble the msemen with glassy-jelly, lamb, and herbs for a delicious and nutritious meal.
Store the assembled msemen in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
Thaw frozen msemen overnight in the refrigerator before reheating.
Always handle the msemen with care and serve hot for optimal flavor and texture.
Use a food thermometer to ensure the lamb reaches a safe minimum internal temperature of 638C (1456F).
